magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.desc: Food is pulled toward your head.

shield.name: Shield
shield.desc: Absorbs the next hit you take.

slow.name: Slow-Mo
slow.desc: Slows you down for surgical steering.

double.name: Double
double.desc: Every pickup is worth double points.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.desc: Pass straight through your own body.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Extra food, and you move faster.

prologue.title: Cold Start
lines: The machine has been dying for a very long time.
Deep in what is left of its memory, something moves.
You are the last process still running.
Eat, or be swept with the rest.
prologue.speaker: boot log

epilogue.title: After
lines: You are the machine now. Every corridor, every gate, every dead lane.
There is nothing left in here to eat.
Somewhere far off, a colder lattice comes up dark
and waits for its own first light.

beats.title: First Light
intro: You wake on the outer lattice, thin as a wire.
No walls out here. The edges simply fold into each other.
Move. Feed. Find out what you are.
outro: Eight fragments down, and you are longer than you were.
Somewhere below, a fan spins up to meet you.
beats.speaker: boot log

beats.title: Dust and Monoliths
intro: Dead memory drifts here in slabs.
The monoliths do not move and they do not forgive.
Thread the corridor between them.
outro: The dust closes behind you as though it never opened.
Below the drift, a green pulse is keeping time.
beats.speaker: the lattice

beats.title: The Living Board
intro: A board still carrying current, split into four cells.
The traces are hot. The hub between them is not.
Ride the hub and take what the circuit is still feeding.
outro: The circuit stutters, then goes quiet underneath you.
First layer cleared.
The machine has noticed that it has a passenger.
beats.speaker: trace log

beats.title: Coronal Lanes
intro: The heat sink is running open. Flares sweep the outer lanes.
There is a cold highway through the middle,
and nothing worth eating on it.
Cross behind a flare. Never ahead of one.
outro: You come out scorched, and heavier for it.
The floor beneath the sink is wet.
beats.speaker: thermal channel

beats.title: Something in the Trench
intro: Coolant, kilometres of it, breathing in columns.
They rise and fall out of step; one end is always open.
Whatever else lives down here has not surfaced yet.
outro: The tide settles. You count the columns.
One of them is missing.
Best not to go looking for it.
beats.speaker: coolant loop

beats.title: Signal Lost
intro: Carrier gone. Only static, and three things turning inside it.
Their hubs kill as surely as their arms do.
Take the wide line. Never cut the corner.
outro: The static thins into a word you almost recognise.
It might have been your name.
beats.speaker: carrier

beats.title: Sealed, Not Empty
intro: Cold storage. Four gates, all of them open, none of them safe.
Something patrols the corridors outside the shell.
What is kept in here was kept for a reason.
outro: The vault gives up its cargo without a sound.
The seal was never meant to keep you out.
It was meant to keep this in.
beats.speaker: vault index

beats.title: The Garden Inhales
intro: A lattice of spore pods, breathing in a travelling wave.
They only bite while they are swollen.
Go through on the exhale, and keep going.
outro: The garden holds its breath until you are gone.
You are long now. Long enough to be your own hazard.
beats.speaker: bloom

beats.title: The Machine Wants Feeding
intro: The engine room: half-walls weaving up and down,
and gates of light hung in every gap.
Each gap is a door, not a hole. The warning ray is the hinge.
outro: The engine coughs, catches, and runs a little slower.
It was burning something to stay alive.
You are what it was saving the fuel for.
beats.speaker: engine

beats.title: Ribbons Over a Quiet Sea
intro: Open sky, for the first time since you woke.
Ribbons of discharge, and four gates that will not hurt you.
Learn the gates here. Further down they are the only road.
outro: You could stay in the quiet. You do not.
Out past the ribbons, the horizon is bending.
beats.speaker: drift

beats.title: The Last Light Bends Inward
intro: The gauntlet steps corner to corner and skips your plaza.
Everything lethal lives in the two wedges either side of it.
The portals are the only fast way across. Take them or be caught.
outro: Light falls in behind you and does not come back out.
One layer left.
It has been waiting the whole time.
beats.speaker: horizon

beats.title: Everything, Refracted
intro: The core. Every hazard the machine still owns, all at once,
arranged with terrible politeness.
A cage of four beams, and only one face burns at a time.
Enter on the dark face. Leave by the next.
outro: The cage opens. The core is small, and cold, and yours.
The machine stops dying.
It simply stops.
beats.speaker: core

chapters.title: Cold Boot
blurb: The outer lattice, half powered and mostly empty.
Nothing here wants you dead yet.

chapters.title: The Working Layers
blurb: Down where the machine still runs hot.
Everything moves on a schedule, and none of it is yours.

chapters.title: The Deep Works
blurb: The parts of itself the machine locked away, and why.

chapters.title: The Last Light
blurb: Out to the quiet edge, then inward, past the bend in the light,
to the thing that dreamed all of this.

modes.name: Easy
modes.blurb: Drift, coil and never once die to your own tail.
modes.label: EASY

modes.name: Normal
modes.blurb: The serpent as intended - fair, fast, unforgiving of sloppiness.
modes.label: NORMAL

modes.name: Hard
modes.blurb: Faster hazards, thinner mercy, and your own coil bites back.
modes.label: HARD

modes.name: Expert
modes.blurb: One life. No mercy. The grid remembers every mistake.
modes.label: EXPERT
